# Zhitao Liu — Public academic CV

Postdoctoral Researcher · Human Geography

Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences

Email: liuzt.20b@igsnrr.ac.cn

ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0823-076X

I am a postdoctoral researcher in human geography at the Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences, working with Prof. Chuanglin Fang. I received my Ph.D. in Human Geography from the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences in 2025, and my bachelor's degree in Human Geography and Urban–Rural Planning from Sun Yat-sen University in 2020.

## Education & appointments

- **2025.07 — | Postdoctoral Researcher** — Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, CAS. Human Geography · Advisor: Prof. Chuanglin Fang
- **2020.09 — 2025.06 | Ph.D. in Human Geography** — University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / IGSNRR, CAS. Advisor: Prof. Chuanglin Fang
- **2016.09 — 2020.06 | Bachelor's degree** — Sun Yat-sen University. Human Geography and Urban–Rural Planning
